I dont know what to think of you, thats because I see a spark of this path i sense possibility and potential of unyielding pursuit, Perhaps im thinking is are you capable are you worthy yet to guide others of the path that you just started, perhaps im wondering how much have you managed to actualy become bhudism itself not follow or chant its teachings, but as I said I can sense a potential, I imagine your reason to pursue is somwhat worthy hence it binds en guide you in a right way. 

Perhaps I take concern with you selling a book, not the book or its contents but intention, as a spiritualist especially bhudism your goal is liberation of you or others or both or my way of liberation of "Us including me", selling means only those who can afford can acquire at the end of a day it becomes who are you exactly helping the few or the all, this is why my first statement,  none the less whatever after, spirituality is sh't else how else would i have remain so poor? for so long, one has to mind everything even moving a finger you have to consider you are not heating whatever baterial could be in the air where ur finger is passing through.

Im not bhudism Im just a spiritual path seeker, so let me give you a gift if you are willing to recive it, anyone can have, hopefully the will be one less hungry spirit I meet in spiritual world, I tell you some spirits in there are way too poverty stricken always looking for opportunity to take something treating me like im their spaza shop, you allow them a finger nail but they will pounce for the whole shoulder at best such greedy thingies. Anyway less my complaints here is the thing.

Dont follow bhudism teaching, learn them, understand them but most iportantly be them. Dont just chant in trance, pause on every word, analyze it in all ways, look at it in multiple angles try to figure its secret not matter how simple the word is in a sentence. Words are just thought translating  experince, what you seek is connect with the original experince of the experience, basically you will be becoming them at that point in time when they wrote or realise that which they recorded as text, basically you are in a way continuing their realization without putting the time en energy required of which they did, think of yourself as becoming a pool that connects to many pools en allows it water to flow from to you, when you read en memorise is like you are using a bucket to carry water that looks like pool number 1 from pond number 100 into your own pool. Now different between being a copy en a seekers lay in the reson, the why are you seeking in the first place, and the is your seeking reason enought that you are willing to die for no matter what, reasons can be changed, reasons dont matter i just that how strong they are ensures you will keep going no matter what , thats is very important in initial path seeking because you will be confused, you will be stuck, your brain will literally crash due to dealing with contrast information en yes constrast due exist en is correct, two beliefs can contradict yet each remain correct, at point you find urself having to hold both beliefs, at this point i would say beliefs are nothing incredible, use them throw them away or create them as you deem necessary they are just usables nothing more else holding on to a beliefs unnecessary will cage you en hold you back, after all we are path seeking, if you use a mountain as only guide even when you have been there en realised its not or no longer the destination u seek then you will alway find your self approaching the mountain no matter how you move away from it. 

Anway purpose will act as a filter as it will at first unconciusly let you choose what you accept as resonating with you or not, then eventually you will modify all that you accpt to suit you best rather than just take in, in that is how you become a seeker en a walker, modifying means you no longer follow but actually walk ur own path, in the begining it would be by looking at others experinces to walk, as you modify them to suite you. then eventually you will use ur realised enlightments to figure your path that is truelly yours, en as you write the experinces to share with others then concrats that how old bhudism sages started, you just became one of them, not first you will right plain thoughts, but as you keep on words start failing to express information you want to pass to the reader, this is where you start expressing intents en will en resonance, you are attemtping to bring the reader to experince what you are saying as you are writing it, this type of writing changes, words are different orderly choice of words is specific, skeeping of words or structure of sentence is specific, basically the text can be read, but better yet the text can be experinced. Hence my gift is be the sage and in such you be come bhudism and eventually become the sage, yes become the sage is a start of the true path as you continue in sagehood en grow deeper en deeper, you realise things like godhood, or deity, or demon, or bhudda are just whats next in the path, just a tiny level higher en you will enter those tittle level, en as you do or near that, you realise there is another top level its little bit more furthers two time distance from sage to godhood or bhudda, that i call prime, or for distiction call them prime spirits, they are one currently standing at the edge of all that is that can be they are old as old can be but anyone can reach them or crawl to them level, so hence i said the constrast, they old as old can be but anyone can join their rant you just have to continue beyong god or bhudda hood for little more longer en you will reach the.

here is a funny thing, Beyong the Prime is nothing, or nothingness, when you move beyoind prime you desolve to nothingness, when you return from nothingness you start in a spirit form, i.e what we are or most humans en animals are basically what you call normies, is like nomie->ghosts en whaterver others -> gods en deities, or deity then god-> long empty path ->prime -> normie its a circle, but its not absolute circle it only means there is an issue currently like death where one die or transition then is lost communication with, but death is almost solved like from weeks back now, by that i mean a living normie can get in spirit world im excluding those like me, by normie i mean anyone with no long term pursuit en self conditioning etc etc.
